answer: The European Data Protection Supervisor (EDPS) deliberately did not issue its 2024 generative AI guidelines in its role as AI Supervisor of the EU institutions under the EU's Artificial Intelligence Act. Instead, a separate strategy is being prepared for that capacity. This is stated in Document 0, which explains that the EDPS issued the guidelines within its role as independent data protection authority of the EU institutions to ensure compliance with Regulation (EU) 2018/1725, but not within its role as AI Supervisor under the AI Act.
